evaluation.method: amendments 1-5: independent split prediction (1/2), comparable partial set (3), min-common base (4), strength-guarded refinement (5)
evaluation.criterion: RMS <= 1 cent and max <= 3 cents over non-base comparable partials; >= 2 non-base comparable partials required. Amendment-3 excludes n<=6 below MIDI72, n<=4 at MIDI72-95, and none from MIDI96. B_rel remains diagnostic.
evaluation.sensitivity_requirement: evaluation outputs must record both guarded (preregistered) and legacy ('off') key statistics as sensitivity rows (amendment-5 section 4.6)
evaluation.dev_side: current production table (Piano88KeyTable.h sha256 c1997c90...) rendered via a temporary Windows Debug unit test (A4=440, 5.2 s, 24-bit, velocity/127), identical to the validation-interp render contract

one_shot: At most one formal batch and one guarded final evaluation after both producers are rendered. Do not inspect comparison metrics, select peaks, choose seeds, or tune on this set before that evaluation. Failed or inconclusive acceptance ends this Task 39-2 capture plan; no replacement batch, added training anchors, retuning or automatic new registration.

closure_policy.legacy_role: Prespecified sensitivity output only, not a second verdict or a way to replace the guarded result.
closure_policy.pass: All 48 registered units have valid identity/state/content/family quality, are evaluable, and meet the unchanged per-unit criterion. Acceptance supports these selected conditions only, not all pitches or a real piano model.
closure_policy.fail: Any evaluable registered unit exceeds the frozen criterion; preserve the failure, table and thresholds, then stop.
closure_policy.inconclusive: Missing units, rejected reference families, insufficient non-base comparable partials or analysis errors prevent acceptance; do not drop rows or replace conditions, then stop.
closure_policy.not_executed: Entry gate failure is recorded as blocked/not executed, not as an acoustic pass.
closure_policy.capture_stop: Unrecoverable identity, protected-state or parameter-state errors stop capture and require safe session closure. Existing bounded GUI action retries may serve the same registered unit only; no extra sessions or replacement batch.
closure_policy.after_any_outcome: Keep the production table, historical verdicts and archived inputs unchanged. No automatic post-failure tool change and re-verdict, extra capture, or parameter fit is authorized.

authorization: User approved production B freeze, no additional training, and the single bounded acceptance limit on 2026-10-14. The user then explicitly approved executing the formal independent acceptance, which authorizes this frozen protocol and the capture launch; the protocol was frozen before any rendering or inspection of this batch's data.
